insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so stormwater runoff isn't a factor right now. The model's main signals right now: hours since high tide is lowering risk — the timing relative to high tide affects how concentrated bacteria are at the shoreline; seasonal pattern is raising risk — seasonal patterns (wet winters vs dry summers) set the baseline risk; and no rain has fallen, so nothing is washing off the land into the surf. The most recent sample, 4 days ago, was excellent at 10 MPN/100mL. It's a naturally clean, well-flushed open-coast beach (unsafe only ~3% of the time), so outside of storms it's reliably safe.
